title: Translate a text
summary: Translate a text into a target language, keeping Markdown and numbers.

sections.use: Translate a text into another language, keeping its Markdown structure, numbers and names.
sections.exclusions: Not a localisation of dates, units or currency; values are kept as written.
sections.limitations: Needs a model context of at least 32,768 tokens (prompt, input, one repair and 8,192 output tokens). Results are model output: review them. Text up to 20,000 characters; the translation may be longer.
sections.missing_data: An empty text gives an empty translation and source_language "unknown".
sections.effects: Sends its inputs to the model of its role (fast by default) and returns the result for review. With unrestricted ports and unrestricted data, that model may be remote; the Add dialog shows the destination. Label inputs Local only to keep them on this machine.
sections.failures: If the reply does not meet the output contract after two repairs, the step fails with located issues. A context or token limit is reported as such; shorten the input or use a larger context.

inputs.target_language: The language to translate into, for example French.
